text:
maya_sales: Heads up — MeridianPay wants a migration POC from CompetitorX. Kickoff 9am PT tomorrow. They care about request/stream compatibility, per-1k token committed pricing, and the vendor security questionnaire before demo.
eli_engineer: They use a custom header flow (X-Client-Stream) + chunked SSE. We can proxy that in a lightweight adapter; plan is a small express shim that rewrites headers and translates SSE chunks to our streaming format. Low effort for POC. @sam_se any model-side parity items to call out? :eyes: 
sam_se: Main prompt parity issues: CompetitorX injects a hidden system prefix and applies top_p=0.85 by default. Recommend mapping: surface their hidden prefix as our system role, and set defaults to temperature=0.15, top_p=0.85 for their traffic. Also prepare a short eval harness (15 prompts) to compare outputs.
nina_infra: Meridian asked for static staging IPs and VPN peer for on-prem test. We can allocate staging-static-ips but will need networking ticket and legal for VPN peering. CC @harry_security.
harry_security: Uploaded SOC2 summary and redacted architecture diagrams to drive. I'll draft answers to their 28-question vendor form but need their KMS/HSM FIPS requirements to confirm. POC can use customer-supplied staging keys if needed.
sam_se: Response post-processing: they strip leading salutations and collapse double line breaks. For parity during POC we'll add a post-process step in the shim to mimic that behavior.
eli_engineer: Quick curl snippet to hand to their engs for streaming test: curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -H 'X-Client-Stream: hdr123' -d '{"model":"redwood-compat-2026","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":400}' https://staging.redwood.example.com/compat/stream
maya_sales: On pricing — they want 1M/mo committed vs on-demand. @rev_finbot can you paste the simple math for committed tiers and a note about dedicated option?
rev_finbot: Baseline on-demand: $0.055 / 1k tokens. Commit 1M/mo -> 18% discount -> $0.0451 / 1k. Commit 2.5M/mo -> 30% discount -> $0.0385 / 1k. Dedicated reserved pool available for strict SLAs (platform fee + minimum term).
maya_sales: I'll include committed tier numbers and a one-time adapter engineering services line in the proposal.
harry_security: Blocker to call out: Meridian requires FIPS-validated KMS for production keywrap. POC ok with staging keys; production will need private deployment or dedicated KMS solution.
eli_engineer: ETA: adapter + post-process + 15-prompt smoke tests in staging in ~36-48 hours. Will post smoke results here.
sam_se: I'll draft the mapping doc and the eval prompts tonight and link them.
maya_sales: Thanks — please drop links and confirm static IP allocation before I loop in their CISO and infra lead. :pray:
